newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends lower vs dlr at 1,075.50.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends lower vs dlr at 1,075.50.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 1.75 pesos lower against the dollar at 1,075.50 after falling under pressure from buying of the U.S. currency by banks, dealers said.
The peso closed slightly higher than its intraday low of 1,075.65 but well off its high for the day of 1,073.
"Banks had short (dollar) positions and they had to go out and buy," one trader said.
Dealers reported 280 trades for a total of $135 million and said they expected to see mostly sideways trading Thursday with the peso holding at about 1,074 to the dollar.
